body:
# Olympus Content

Olympus Content is the custom content mod for **Olympus**, the modded branch of the whitelisted Minecraft server **Theatria**.

This mod is designed for the official [Olympus Mod Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/olympus-theatria-mod-pack) and is required to connect to the Olympus server. It adds server-specific items, mechanics, and progression content made specifically for the long-term Olympus experience.

For more information about Olympus, read the official [Olympus documentation](https://docs.playtheatria.com/olympus/readme).

## Current Features

### Sunfish

The Sunfish is a rare custom fish found through fishing. When used in the Overworld, it changes the world from night to day.

### Nightfish

The Nightfish is a rare custom fish found through fishing. When used in the Overworld, it changes the world from day to night.

These items give players a survival-friendly way to influence time without relying on commands, warps, or admin intervention.

## Planned Content

Olympus Content will expand over time with additional server-specific features, including:

- Custom items
- Custom mobs
- Custom blocks
- Progression content
- Olympus-specific survival mechanics

Planned features are not included until they are released in a version of the mod.

## Server Usage

This mod is primarily intended for the official [Olympus Mod Pack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/olympus-theatria-mod-pack) and the Olympus server. It may work in singleplayer or other worlds, but the content is designed around the Olympus multiplayer experience.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.1
- Loader: NeoForge
- Environment: Client and server required

## About Olympus

Olympus is a long-term modded survival server connected to Theatria. It is built around exploration, persistence, player-driven projects, and minimal admin interference.

Read more about Olympus here:

[Olympus Documentation](https://docs.playtheatria.com/olympus/readme)
